name: Rhudaur Town Centre
desc1: This large circular plaza is littered with the makeshift homes of
desc2: vagrants and street thugs. It is paved with broken flagstones, and is
desc3: littered with debris even more heavily than the main streets. In the
desc4: centre of the plaza is a disfigured bronze statue of a proud mounted
desc5: knight raising his sword in the air-- it has been covered with crude
desc6: painted graffiti. Four streets branch out from this plaza, Shadow
desc7: street north, Dagger west, Flame east, and Temple street south.
